title: Export invoices as CSV
description:
Accounting wants to import our invoices into their bookkeeping tool. We already have a JSON export (`python -m invoicing export --format json`); please add CSV as a second format.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python -m invoicing export --format csv --output <file>` writes all invoices as CSV
- [ ] One row per invoice with the columns: invoice number, customer name, issue date, due date, total, status
- [ ] A header row with these column names
- [ ] Dates in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), totals with exactly two decimals
- [ ] With no invoices, the file contains only the header row
- [ ] The JSON export keeps working unchanged
